materials.content:
Watercolor and graphite on medium thick, white, smooth wove paper
(Source: Paper Survey researched by Judith C. Walsh and published in Lynes, 1999.)

remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. See cat. no. 792. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: In this minimalist, semiabstract work, a thin strip of brown paint denotes flat desert land. Above this land are a few bright blue mountains, and below are blue forms that could denote a twisting river or shady hill. Surrounding these loose brushstrokes is an expanse of plain white paper.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
title: Untitled (Taos Landscape)
